name: @nvidia/nemoclaw-openclaw
description: OpenClaw agent runtime package for NemoClaw

scripts.build:runtime: nemoclaw-materialize-runtime managed-gateway runtime/managed-gateway-control.py && nemoclaw-materialize-runtime messaging-build messaging/messaging-build.mts
scripts.check:runtime: nemoclaw-materialize-runtime managed-gateway runtime/managed-gateway-control.py --check && nemoclaw-materialize-runtime messaging-build messaging/messaging-build.mts --check
scripts.test:package: npm run check:adapters && npm run check:runtime && npm run check:package && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && npm run test:plugin
scripts.test:nemoclaw: npm --prefix plugin run build && vitest run --config vitest.nemoclaw.ts && npm run test:fabric:composed
scripts.test:plugin: npm --prefix plugin run build && npm --prefix plugin test
scripts.test:spec: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --reporter=tree && vitest run --config vitest.nemoclaw.ts --reporter=tree && npm --prefix plugin test -- --reporter=tree
scripts.test: npm run test:package && npm run test:nemoclaw
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.adapters.json && tsc -p jsconfig.json && npm --prefix plugin run typecheck
